notes.title: 🎉 Celebrate with Us: Epic Launch Sale! 🎉
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of our first major RPG, Umbra: The Last Summoner! 

Dive into the mystical realms and epic battles right from the start: 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710560?utm_source=epidiscount


To make this launch even more spectacular, we're offering massive discounts on all our games during launch week! This is our way of celebrating with our incredible community — your support means the world to us.

Don't miss out on the excitement! 
Enjoy the special prices, and make sure to wishlist and explore the rich, captivating world of Umbra: The Last Summoner.
